golden_rule: Do not create the final vPlan until scope and minimum evidence readiness are established.
subsystem_intake: Ask which subsystem/protocol is being verified.
Ask DUT role/topology/boundary and intended verification level.
Ask for protocol specification and revision.
Ask for DUT design specification and supported/unsupported feature list.
Ask for register/programming guide where applicable.
Ask for PHY/interface and clock/reset documentation.
Ask for RTL top/interface sources or port list.
Ask for VIP manual/examples/source/class reference if VIP will be used.
Ask for existing UVM env/vPlan/tests/command.txt/regression/coverage if available.
Ask for known waivers and their design-spec evidence.
system_level_intake: Ask which completed subsystems will be composed.
Ask for each subsystem manifest/release-SHA/qualification state.
Ask system-level use cases and end-to-end scenarios.
Ask cross-subsystem configuration sequence and boot dependencies.
Ask unsupported combinations and approved waivers.
